subtitle: 24 deck-building challenges for December
instructions: Open a day, build your deck and share it by December 31. Each challenge leaves room for your own strategy.

1.title: A Clan for Christmas
1.content: At least 75% of your crypt copies must belong to one clan. Other clans may provide support.

2.title: A Light in the Longest Night
2.content: At least 50% of all card copies in your deck must appear in New Blood: Salubri.

3.title: Something Stirs in the Snow
3.content: Build a deck classified as Gangrel Thing.

4.title: The Star of the Long Night
4.content: Include at least 3 copies of one vampire in your crypt.

5.title: The Winter Council
5.content: Include at least 8 Political Action cards.

6.title: Mirages on Christmas Eve
6.content: At least 50% of all card copies in your deck must appear in New Blood: Ravnos.

7.title: Royalty After Dark
7.content: Build a deck classified as Haqim Royalty.

9.title: An Anarch Christmas
9.content: At least 75% of your crypt copies must be vampires with the printed Anarch sect.

10.title: Home for the Long Night
10.content: At least 50% of all card copies in your deck must appear in New Blood: Tzimisce.

11.title: Break the Winter Bonds
11.content: Build a deck classified as Ravnos Break.

12.title: The Elders Gather
12.content: At least half of your crypt copies must be vampires with capacity 8 or higher.

14.title: Secrets of New York
14.content: At least 25% of all card copies in your deck must appear in Secrets of New York.

15.title: The Tyrant’s Christmas Speech
15.content: Build a deck classified as Aaradhya Vote.

16.title: An Unlikely Alliance
16.content: Include vampires from at least two clans, with no required split.

18.title: Noites Brasileiras
18.content: At least 25% of all card copies in your deck must appear in Noites Brasileiras.

19.title: A Place at the Council
19.content: Build a deck classified as Toreador Loup.

20.title: The Next Generation
20.content: At least half of your crypt copies must be vampires with capacity 5 or lower.

22.title: Guests from Beyond
22.content: Build a deck classified as Oblivion Allies Swarm.

23.title: A Shared Gift
23.content: Choose a discipline possessed by at least 75% of your crypt copies, at either level. Include at least 10 library cards listing that same discipline. Other disciplines are welcome.

24.title: Your Gift to the Community
24.content: Gift your best deck to the VTES community! Share a deck you are proud of and would bring to the table. Any legal deck, any clan, any strategy—no additional restrictions.
